map.如何使用按行过滤？: How do I use Line Filter?
map.按行过滤适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Line Filter best for?
map.日志筛选：只保留含「ERROR」或排除「DEBUG」的行，聚焦问题。: Log screening: keep only lines containing "ERROR" or excluding "DEBUG" to focus on issues.
map.名单处理：按关键词包含/不包含过滤，得到目标子集。: List processing: filter by keyword include / exclude to get the target subset.
map.数据预处理：过滤掉空行或特定前缀行，准备下游处理。: Data pre-processing: drop blank lines or specific prefixes, ready for downstream use.
map.粘贴 5000 行日志，设「包含 ERROR」，输出仅 23 行错误；再叠加「排: Paste 5000 log lines, set "contains ERROR", output only 23 error lines; stacking "exclude timeout" further removes known noise.
map.支持。简单子串与正则模式两种；复杂条件（如「A 且非 B」）可用正则或组合多次过: Yes. Both simple substring and regex modes; complex conditions (like "A and not B") use regex or combined multiple passes.
map.默认敏感，可开忽略大小写；「error」与「ERROR」在敏感模式下是两条不同匹: Case-sensitive by default; you can enable ignore-case; "error" and "ERROR" are two different matches in sensitive mode.
